description.value: Albasha Express is a fast-casual Mediterranean restaurant in Kitsilano, Vancouver, specializing in made-to-order shawarma, falafel, hummus, and kebabs. Situated on Cornwall Avenue close to the waterfront seawall, it is a convenient refueling stop for cyclists riding between downtown and Kits Beach. The restaurant holds a 4.5-star Google rating and serves over 1,000 customers weekly, reflecting a strong local following.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 8m; rack (3 spaces) at 14m; rack (3 spaces) at 26m; stands (2 spaces) at 45m; stands (2 spaces) at 46m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active business at this Kitsilano location serving Mediterranean fast-casual food, with pickup ordering and a broad vegetarian menu clearly described. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content. A notable discrepancy exists: OSM names this business 'Al Basha' while the website consistently uses 'Albasha Express', suggesting a rebrand.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Al Basha' but the website consistently uses 'Albasha Express' — likely a rebrand; OSM record may need updating.
No phone number present in OSM tags or visible in website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant on Cornwall Avenue in Kitsilano, directly adjacent to the seawall cycling corridor; offers no-fee pickup and strong vegetarian options that would benefit touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian items: Signature Falafels Plate, Veggie Lover plate (falafels with dolmathes), made-to-order falafel wraps, hummus, tabouleh, dolmathes, lentil soup, and tzatziki
